summary: Suspend bombs in exile with Jhoira, soak timers with extra upkeeps, then free-cast haste creatures and redraw loops.

tags.name: suspend
tags.reason: Commander and most payoffs are suspend or time-counter cards.

tags.name: time counters
tags.reason: Timer hacks, Paradox Haze, Ninth Doctor, and Chronozoa all manipulate time counters.

tags.name: spellslinger
tags.reason: Instants and sorceries for draw, rebound, Delay, and Capsize support the tub.

tags.name: flashback
tags.reason: Think Twice and Surreal Memoir redo; not the primary plan.

tags.name: time lords
tags.reason: The Ninth Doctor is a soak piece, not a Doctor's companion shell.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Inevitable Betrayal steals one big creature after cooking.

tags.name: extra turns
tags.reason: No extra-turn spells; only extra upkeeps from Paradox Haze and Ninth Doctor.
